# base

The system layer: kernel, bootloader, networking, sudo and the tools install.sh itself needs.

archinstall installs most of it; it is declared so a clean install and `tools/docs --drift` agree. NetworkManager uses iwd for Wi-Fi; zram swap compresses with zstd (both files in `base/root/etc/`).

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`base/packages`): `base`, `base-devel` (makepkg, for AUR packages), `linux`, `linux-zen`, `linux-firmware`, `mkinitcpio`, `grub`, `efibootmgr`, `f2fs-tools`, `sudo`, `zram-generator`, `networkmanager`, `iwd` (NetworkManager's Wi-Fi backend (etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/wifi_backend.conf)), `ufw`, `git`, `less`, `unzip`, `zip`, `net-tools`, `jq`, `libnotify` (notify-send), `xdg-user-dirs`, `stow` (install.sh --link), `python` (theme engine)

**System files** (`base/root/`, copied by `install.sh --system`):

- `/etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/wifi_backend.conf`
- `/etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf`

**`setup.sh`** (run by `install.sh --setup`): system services this desktop relies on, and the XDG user dirs (~/Pictures for screenshots, ~/Downloads for blueman).
